about.description: The Alabama Gulf Coast Zoo is a richly diverse and decidedly unique small-town community zoo located in Gulf Shores, Alabama. Every animal at the zoo has a story. The zoo features a wide variety of animals including giraffes, big cats, monkeys, baboons, bobcats, camels, reptiles, birds, and more. Guests can enjoy daily keeper chats, animal feedings, a walk-through aviary, a contact barn, and special add-on experiences like walking in the lemur enclosure and giraffe feeding tickets. The zoo also hosts special events such as the Art on the Wild Side: Wine & Whiskey Stroll.
about.elevator_pitch: A uniquely diverse Gulf Shores zoo where every animal has a story and guests can enjoy daily keeper chats, giraffe feedings, and immersive animal encounters.
what_provided: daily keeper chats included with admission
about.age_restriction: Some events are 18+ or 21+ (e.g., Wine & Whiskey Stroll)
about.reservations: Tickets available online; some add-on experiences (giraffe feeding, lemur enclosure walk) require separate purchase
about.insider_tip: Arrive early for the 9:15 AM Bird Chat at South American Adventure, and budget extra for the giraffe feeding experience — kids love it!

specials.name: Giraffe Feeding

specials.name: Lemur Enclosure Walk
specials.description: Walk inside the lemur enclosure for an up-close wildlife experience. Available for an additional $25 per person.

specials.name: Art on the Wild Side: Wine & Whiskey Stroll
specials.description: Annual adult event (21+) featuring an online auction of exclusive artwork created by the zoo animals, running March 21–28 with an in-person stroll on March 28.
